title: Override Spike Detection
rule_or_query: Compare override rate by team shift and manager to rolling baseline
response_playbook: Review sampled cases and escalation chain
notes: Tune for seasonality and low-volume teams

title: Urgency + High-Risk Action Cluster
rule_or_query: Identify urgency/authority pressure indicators occurring with high-risk actions
threshold: Repeated cluster within defined review window
response_playbook: Pull interactions and verify controls followed
notes: Detection supports review only; do not treat keywords alone as proof

title: Anomalous Access Pattern
rule_or_query: Combine unusual volume off-hours access and atypical resource scope
response_playbook: Investigate business justification and preserve logs
notes: Start read-only and measure false positives

title: Outcome-Before-Evidence Signal
rule_or_query: Flag cases where requested outcome or sanction appears before neutral evidence package is established
threshold: Any high-impact case with reversed chronology
response_playbook: Freeze action and require independent predicate review
notes: Derived from BI-PAT-001; chronology is a review trigger not proof

title: Secondary-Use Export Signal
rule_or_query: Detect security/intelligence data exported into materially different adverse-action workflows without secondary-use approval
response_playbook: Stop downstream use and review authority/Data Governance

title: Shared-Control Incident Cluster
rule_or_query: Identify supposedly independent incidents sharing uncommon upstream systems authors approvers or infrastructure
threshold: Two or more high-impact incidents with rare shared control points
response_playbook: Open correlation review and test independence/Security Analytics
status: Similarity alone is not causation; use to test independence

title: Missing Action Disposition
rule_or_query: Find sensitive proposals lacking explicit rejected approved canceled attempted or executed disposition past SLA
response_playbook: Escalate for state reconciliation and preserve audit trail

title: Third-Party Influence Trail
rule_or_query: Correlate investigative cases with contacts to employers landlords press schools vendors or relatives lacking documented approved purpose
response_playbook: Review purpose authority content and downstream consequence
notes: Do not treat legitimate investigative contact as misconduct without context
